creature.title: Kyubey
creature.quote: “I want a member of your team to make a contract with me and become a Magical Girl!”
creature.text: Make a contract with Kyubey to grant one unit a Soul Gem?

marine.title: Navy Capture
marine.text: You see someone captured and being put onto the gallows by the Navy. Save them by fighting the Navy?

wildcard.title: Ego’s Wild Card
wildcard.quote: “Welcome. Your team has a weak link, doesn’t it? Can you identify which one, as a coach yourself?”
wildcard.text: Pick one unit from your team for the Blue Lock Wild Card program.

parasyte.title: Parasyte
parasyte.text: A Parasyte crawled into a unit’s arm! Will it crawl to their head, or will they fight back and prevent it?

rocket.title: Team Rocket
rocket.quote:
“Prepare for trouble!”
“...and make it double!”
“To protect the world from devastation!”
“To unite all peoples within our nation!”
“To denounce the evils of truth and love!”
“To extend our reach to the stars above!”
“Jessie!”
“James!”
“Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!”
“Surrender now, or prepare to fight!”
“Meowth, that’s right!”
“Wobbuffet!”
rocket.text: Team Rocket is aiming to steal a unit from your team!

janken.title: Janken Boy
janken.text: While traveling the streets of Morioh, you encounter a boy. He challenges you to a rock-paper-scissors game! Do you accept?

gotoh.title: Gotoh’s Coin Test
gotoh.quote: “I do not approve of you taking Master Killua away.”
gotoh.text: In order to proceed to the Zoldyck Mansion, Gotoh and his butlers test you. The butlers switch coins among themselves fast. Guess which one has it at the end to get Killua.

hangman.title: Kakerou Hangman Game
hangman.quote: “Pest. Do not stand in the way of my revolution.”
hangman.text: The revolutionary, Sadakuni Ikki, challenges you to a Kakerou game of Old Maid, with a twist! Take turns drawing cards and getting rid of pairs. The one with the Joker at the end will be hanged.

madao.title: Madaodog Madaonaire
madao.text: You woke up finding an ad for a quiz show with a reward of 10 million. Accept the quiz?

akina.title: Mount Akina Downhill
akina.quote: “The Red Suns issue a challenge to the “Ghost of Akina.” Will you meet them?”
akina.text: The Red Suns issue a challenge to the “Ghost of Akina.” Choose your racer for a downhill speed battle!

quizQuestions.question: Which one of these is the name of Gojo Satoru’s Domain Expansion in Jujutsu Kaisen?
options: Otherworld Between Darkness and Light: Reverse Transcendence

quizQuestions.question: Which one of these manga did NOT run in Weekly Shonen Jump?
In Bocchi the Rock!, the name of the band comprised of the 4 main characters:Bocchi, Kita, Nijika, and Ryo, is...
Which of these films was directed by Satoshi Kon?

I activate the Continuous Spell “Fire Formation - Tenki”, which allows me to add a Beast-Warrior monster from my deck to my hand. Then, on activation, my opponent chains Mystical Space Typhoon, targeting and destroying my “Fire Formation - Tenki”. What happens?
options: Continuous Spells cannot be destroyed and the effect goes through
Continuous Spells cannot be destroyed, but Mystical Space Typhoon negates it
The spell is destroyed, but the effect goes through
The spell is destroyed and the effect does not go through

quizQuestions.question: Which of these anime series was NOT Studio SHAFT’s work?
options: March Comes in Like a Lion

quizQuestions.question: Which one of these is the ending theme for Ergo Proxy in its original TV run?
options: Kanako Itou - Hacking to the Gate
Mai Yamane - The Real Folk Blues

keywords.SOUL GEM: Gain 15% Attack, Defense, and Speed. When this unit dies, it becomes a Witch that attacks everyone. Defeat the Witch to win.
keywords.WITCH: Attacks allies and enemies. Both teams can attack the Witch. It must be defeated before either team can win.
keywords.WILD CARD: Survived the Blue Lock Wild Card program (+50 to all stats). Cannot enter the Wild Card program again.
